name: screen-guide
description: Ask the local Windows screen guide to highlight real software controls while you click them yourself.

interface.shortDescription: Find controls in real Windows apps. You perform every action.
interface.longDescription: The current conversation model reads the live interface and chooses each entry. The local app verifies bounds, draws click-through highlights and observes your own clicks. Hybrid mode shares current control metadata and a target-window image. No automatic clicks, typing or microphone activation.
